title: Canada explores ‘associate member’ status with EU amid US trade tensions
summary_full: Canada explores becoming an associate member of the European Union. Prime Minister Mark Carney seeks stronger economic and strategic ties with the bloc. This move comes as Canada's trade relationship with the United States has worsened. Discussions focus on free movement of goods, services, and workers. Deeper cooperation is also being considered in energy and technology sectors.
